description: This file is a Perl module that provides an interface to the Git version control system, implementing various methods to execute Git commands, manage repositories, retrieve configurations, and handle credentials. It defines the package Git and its related error class, along with numerous subroutines for interacting with Git and processing its output.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors generated by executing external Git commands, encapsulating command line, exit code, and output.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new repository object, determining the repository and working directory paths based on provided options or current directory.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a specified Git command with optional arguments, returning output based on context (scalar or list).

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns the first line of its output as a scalar string.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and returns a filehandle for reading its output, along with context info.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and returns a writeable filehandle for providing input to it.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned by command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe, checking for command success.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Starts a bidirectional pipe to a Git command, returning process ID and handles for interacting.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes a bidirectional pipe, waiting for command termination and checking success.

methods.name: command_noisy
methods.description: Executes a Git command without capturing output; the output goes directly to standard output.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current Git version string.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's executable directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Calculates and returns the timezone offset from GMT for a given timestamp or current time.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle, separated by a specified delimiter.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input, considering environment variables for askpass utilities.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository directory path for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the working copy path for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory within the working copy for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the working directory subpath for a repository object.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Fetches Git configuration variable value.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Fetches a boolean Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Fetches a path-type Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Fetches an integer Git configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Fetches all Git configuration keys matching a regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines if color should be used for a named operation from config.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration for a slot, with default fallback.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Retrieves references (refs) from a remote repository, optionally filtered.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses author or committer identity info from Git variable.

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Formats and returns name and email from ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of a file considering it as a specific Git object type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of a file and inserts the object into Git database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a blob object to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts service name or port number to numeric port.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Executes git credential commands to fill, approve, or reject credentials.

methods.name: temp_acquire
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a temporary file mapped to a name, locking it.

methods.name: temp_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if a temporary file mapped to a name is currently locked.

methods.name: temp_release
methods.description: Releases lock and resets a temporary file, associated with a name or handle.

methods.name: temp_reset
methods.description: Truncates and resets position in a temporary file handle.

methods.name: temp_path
methods.description: Returns filename associated with a temporary file handle or name.

methods.name: prefix_lines
methods.description: Prefixes each line of a string with a specified prefix.

methods.name: unquote_path
methods.description: Decodes a quoted path string with C-escapes into normal path string.

methods.name: get_comment_line_char
methods.description: Fetches core.commentchar config, defaults to '#'.

methods.name: comment_lines
methods.description: Prefixes lines with comment character for comment blocks.
